Key.Original: Type part of an item's name (as the arsenal shows it), then PIN IT.
Search every loaded mod for gear with this name and pin the best match.

THE BAZAAR
Stock rotates on the timer - what you see is what they have today. Single items go straight into your kit. BULK CRATES are sealed: haul them to HQ and unpack them into the arsenal. Lose the crate, lose the goods.
How many to buy - type any number up to what the trader has left. Bulk crates are always one per buy.

Where single-item purchases go: straight into your kit, into the cargo of a vehicle parked within 15m of you, or into an open crate beside the stall (repeat buys fill the same crate). Bulk crates always come sealed.
Wanted List: pin the selected item and hear in chat the moment any trader has it (as a single, a sealed crate, or a job asking for it). Up to 10 pins, kept in your profile. Press again to unpin.
Where else are traders set up right now, when do they restock, who has your Wanted List pins, and how are the smuggling runs going?
